skill_name: Which fields have seen the most significant applications of digitalization?
workflow: Digitalization has had significant applications in fields such as healthcare, education, finance, retail, and transportation. In healthcare, digitalization has enabled remote patient monitoring, online doctor visits, artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) applications for diagnosis, and automated medical records and insurance processing.
